{{Quote|Wesa have little favor to ask you. We wanta new Gungan city on the empty moon. But there's no life there. Nottin to build with, nottin to eat.|Boss Nass, to Amidala and Kenobi|<ref name="TGF" />}}
The '''colonization''' of the [[Water/Legends|water]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] was the result of a joint effort between the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|inhabitants]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The Gungan [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Nass]], initiator of the project, enlisted the help of his new allies, [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to bring the [[Plant/Legends|plants]] and creatures destined to populate the empty moon. While the mission was successful and led to the establishment of [[New Otoh Gunga]], a majority of the colony was destroyed about [[22 BBY/Legends|ten years later]] when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] used its poisonous [[swamp gas]] on the Gungans during the [[Battle of Ohma-D'un]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Yousa no tinken yousa greater den da Gungans&hellip; Mesa like dis. Maybe wesa bein friends.|Boss Nass to Queen Amidala|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
[[File:Naboo_celebration.jpg|thumb|left|250px|]]
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the two [[Sentience/Legends|sapient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that called [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] had forged an alliance after millennia of mutual mistrust: the Humans and Gungans had united their forces to reclaim their planet, which had been [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|subjugated]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. In the ensuing period of prosperity and collaboration, the Gungan [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] changed his long-standing policy of seclusion, opened the underwater [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of Otoh Gunga to offworld visitors.<ref name="db">{{DB|character|bossnass|Nass, Boss}}</ref> Because of that, the city gained more and more inhabitants, until it became threatened by overpopulation. Intent on preserving the ecological balance of [[Lake Paonga/Legends|Lake Paonga]], in which the capital was located, and of the surrounding wilderness, Nass decided to establish a new colony on the [[Water/Legends|water]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]], the largest of the three natural satellites in orbit around Naboo.<ref name="db" />

==The colonization==
{{Quote|Wanna yousa bring da plants and animals in the big bongo ship? Yousa release the right critters so that the moon bombad busy with life! Then wesa come to the moon.|Boss Nass, to Amidala and Kenobi|<ref name="TGF" />}}
To help him handle that critical mission, Boss Nass turned to his new ally, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of [[Naboo (people)/Legends|the Naboo]]. Under the guidance of [[Graf Zapalo/Legends|Graf Zapalo]], chief science advisor to Amidala, Gungan scientists and Naboo starship engineers worked together to come up with a number of new technologies. The crowning achievement of that collaboration was the [[Mantaris-class amphibious medium transport|''Mantaris''-class amphibious medium transport]], a spaceworthy version of the traditional Gungan [[bongo]] [[Submarine/Legends|submersible]].<ref name="Manta" /> In the mean time, the Gungans collected creatures and plants from Naboo and many other worlds such as [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], hoping they would thrive on the empty water moon.<ref name="TGF" />

Before the arrival of the Gungan colonists, the [[Gungan High Council/Legends|Gungan High Council]] asked Queen Amidala to travel to Ohma-D'un in the company of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], the Gungan Bombad General [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. Together, they were to discover how the animals and plants they intended to introduce on the moon's surface would interact and how they would depend on each other to live. Once they obtained an ecologically sound environment, the Gungan settlers started to harvest valuable resources and use them to build the [[New Otoh Gunga]]. The [[Doctor/Legends|physician]] [[Portillo]], a citizen named [[Josie]], a [[Unidentified Gungan librarian|male librarian]]<ref name="TGF" /> and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Toba]] were among the first settlers.<ref name="Toba" />

At some point during the colonization process, a shipment of machine parts was to transit from [[Oxon City|Oxon]] to Ohma-D'un, but ultimately got hijacked by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] before it could reach the moon installation. A group of heroes was subsequently assigned to escort all future shipments. After conducting a number of uneventful escorts, the heroes ended up facing another raid. With the help of one of the pirate fighters, who suddenly changed sides, the escort managed to take the pirate leader captive, forcing the entire group's surrender.<ref name="Starf">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=starfighter_stats|text="The Starfighter Trap" Character Statistics}}</ref>

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|The Confederacy has turned Ohma-D'un into a graveyard&hellip;|Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="SWR:TNFOW">''[[Star Wars: Republic: The New Face of War]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Swamp_Gas.jpg|thumb|200px|The colonists of Ohma-D'un were decimated by the swamp gas in 21.8 BBY.]]
Although the colonization effort was successful, the new Gungan moon did not enjoy its newfound propserity for long. In [[22 BBY/Legends|21.8 BBY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> while the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] were being fought throughout the galaxy, Ohma-D'un was the scene of a [[Battle of Ohma-D'un|battle]] bewteen the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. While the Republic emerged victorious from that battle, the Gungan colony had been decimated by the Confederacy's deadly [[swamp gas]].<ref name="SWR:TNFOW" />
